title: Engine Cooling System Safety
introduction: I treat the coolant cap as the lid of a pressurized vessel: loosening it can release what is inside. Cooling the engine is essential preparation before opening the system. This page explains that opening hazard; draining, filling and pressure testing require their own instructions.

edits.text: WARNING: Always let the engine cool before opening the cooling system. Never unscrew the coolant pressure relief cap while the engine is operating or while the cooling system is hot. The system is pressurized, and loosening the cap even slightly can forcefully release steam and hot liquid. Failure to follow these instructions may cause serious personal injury.
edits.why: The danger begins as soon as the cap loosens enough to release pressure; leaving it partly attached does not prevent a forceful discharge.
